name: Transforming Flourish
oracle_text:
Demonstrate (When you cast this spell, you may copy it. If you do, choose an opponent to also copy it. Players may choose new targets for their copies.)
Destroy target artifact or creature you don't control. If that permanent is destroyed this way, its controller exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then they may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Destroy target artifact or creature you don't control. If that permanent is destroyed this way, its controller exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then they may cast that card without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a caster key on the free-cast ops (exile_until's cast_free, and play_exiled) naming a player spec other than the effect's controller, so "its controller exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile a nonland card, then THEY may cast that card without paying its mana cost" offers the cast to the destroyed permanent's controller (e.g. {"controller_of": <snapshot binding>}) and that player controls the resulting spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile_until already walks another player's library via `player`, but its docstring and code route the free-cast offer to ctx.controller always (_offer_free_cast(ctx, controller, ...)), which is Strago and Relm's "You may cast that card"; play_exiled, cast_card and cast_from_hand likewise cast as the resolving controller. Writing it that way would hand the opponent's free spell to the Flourish's caster, a strictly different (and much stronger) card. Demonstrate itself and the conditional destroy (destroy `as` + an `if` on `exists`) are expressible; only the caster of the free spell is not.
